summary: Phase 3 install chain and master-owned placement fault/recovery acceptance in an ISO-installed two-host lab; fixes found there: ISO build fetches its pinned OVMF from a snapshot (BUG-0533), bundled media folder is traversable under the service umask (BUG-0534), a joined host's network follows it into the pool (BUG-0535), a create interrupted before allocation or refused before execution settles as failed and releases its master record (BUG-0536), a refused update releases the master reservation (BUG-0537), and a delete prunes a record with an unresolved update (BUG-0538). Lab harnesses support a shared tap bridge, enforcing Secure Boot, reinstall onto used disks and the current wizard layout.

guide.reason: Create a VM troubleshooting gains the repair for hosts installed 0.3.0-0.4.5 whose local ISO folder blocks uploads (BUG-0534). The interrupted-create and lost-reply fixes make existing guide statements true (a failed creation before Core defines a VM reserves no name) and need no new steps.

api.reason: Core-peer POST /api/v1/pool/vms/inventory: `deleted` also lists VMs whose only create failed while validating, and new optional `aborted` (operation ID to FailedVMUpdateEvidence) lets the master abort a matching pending_update; the owner-record prune no longer waits on a pending update when a delete tombstone exists. Older members omit `aborted` and keep previous behaviour. Controller API and Controller/Core command contracts are unchanged; the Controller network projection fix restores the documented GET /api/v1/networks pool_id. Documented in docs/API.md.

roadmap.reason: The public roadmap moves the Phase 3 install chain, emulated Secure Boot install, several-disk install and interrupted install to done, keeps an interrupted Controller deployment open, and drops the hosted-checks item the project owner signed off; real hardware stays open.

state.reason: Settlement evidence lives in each host's managed journal (a refused or interrupted create/update recorded failed at stage validating) and the pool master's pool-vms.json owner records; the Controller stores nothing new.
state.record: Member: /var/lib/nex-core-agent/managed-vms journal entries (failed, stage validating). Master: /var/lib/nex-core-agent/pool-vms.json, pruned or with pending_update aborted from the owner's authenticated pool VM inventory. A fresh Controller re-adopts the master's records and therefore no longer sees phantom VMs.

verification.method: Regression tests failing before and passing after each fix: tests.test_storage_packaging (BUG-0533), TestSeedBundledMediaCreatesTraversableDirectoryUnderServiceUmask (BUG-0534), TestJoinedMemberNetworkProjectionFollowsJoinedPool (BUG-0535), TestInterruptedCreateAtValidatingSettlesAsProvenFailure / TestInterruptedCreateAtValidatingSettlesWithoutRetry / TestProvenFailedCreateReleasesMasterRecord (BUG-0536), TestRefusedUpdateReleasesMasterReservation / TestRecordedRefusalIsReturnedOnRedelivery (BUG-0537), TestDeletedOwnerVMPrunesRecordWithUnresolvedUpdate (BUG-0538); go test ./internal/agent ./internal/vmhost ./internal/controller. Native: ISO-installed nested-KVM lab walkthrough recorded in the QA record, including the live phantom records clearing after the fixed nex-core-local was deployed and tests/integration/placement_faults.py lost-reply, shared-edit, storage-loss (stop and fsid), membership, interrupt and replacement passing. Physical hardware and the post-fix master-side lost-reply ordering were not observed.
